string.text: {=AiRecruitFiefTroopsBehavior_RegisterEvents_0}[ModifiedArmy] 封邑招募行为已加载并注册事件
{=Recruit_Troops_Prosperity_Cost_0}[ModifiedArmy] {PARTY_NAME}在{SETTLEMENT_NAME}招募了{TROOP_COUNT}名士兵，消耗{PROSPERITY_COST}点繁荣度
{=Recruit_Troops_Hearth_Cost_0}[ModifiedArmy] {PARTY_NAME}在{SETTLEMENT_NAME}招募了{TROOP_COUNT}名士兵，消耗{PROSPERITY_COST}点户数
{=FiefWageExemptionManager_ClearAllExemptions_0}[ModifiedArmy] 已清除{PARTY_NAME}的所有工资豁免
{=FiefWageExemptionManager_AddExemption_0}[ModifiedArmy] {PARTY_NAME}获得了{COUNT}名士兵的工资豁免, 持续{DAYS}天
{=FiefPartyData_EnforceTroopLimits_0}[ModifiedArmy] 因兵力超限, 从{SETTLEMENT_NAME}移除了{RETINUE}名扈从, {SERGEANT}名军士, {MILITIA}名民兵

{=FiefPartyData_ReturnTroopsToSettlement_1}[封邑] {PARTY_NAME}在{SETTLEMENT_NAME}解散了{RETURNED_COUNT}名士兵, 提升{PROSPERITY_COST}点繁荣度, 归还附属村庄{HEARTH_COST}点户数. 当前封邑兵力: 扈从{RETINUE_COUNT}/{MAX_RETINUE}, 军士{SERGEANT_COUNT}/{MAX_SERGEANT}, 水兵{MARINE_COUNT}/{MAX_MARINE}, 军事奴隶{SLAVE_COUNT}/{MAX_SLAVE}, 民兵{MILITIA_COUNT}/{MAX_MILITIA}, 总计{TROOP_COUNT}/{TOTAL_LIMIT}.

{=FiefPartyData_WeeklyUpdate_0}[ModifiedArmy] {SETTLEMENT_NAME}补充了{RETINUE}名扈从, {SERGEANT}名军士, {MARINE}名水兵, {SLAVE}名军事奴隶, {MILITIA}名民兵, 当前封邑兵力：扈从{RETINUE_COUNT}/{MAX_RETINUE}, 军士{SERGEANT_COUNT}/{MAX_SERGEANT}, 水兵{MARINE_COUNT}/{MAX_MARINE}, 军事奴隶{SLAVE_COUNT}/{MAX_SLAVE}, 民兵{MILITIA_COUNT}/{MAX_MILITIA}, 总计{TROOP_COUNT}/{TOTAL_LIMIT}

{=FiefPartyData_RecruitTroopsToParty_0}[ModifiedArmy] {PARTY_NAME}从{SETTLEMENT_NAME}招募了{RETINUE}名扈从, {SERGEANT}名军士, {MARINE}名水兵, {SLAVE}名军事奴隶, {MILITIA}名民兵, 消耗{PROSPERITY_COST}点繁荣度, 消耗附属村庄{HEARTH_COST}点户数
{=ModifiedArmy_PartyWageLimitEvaluated}[部队财政] {PARTY_NAME}每日工资为{CURRENT_WAGE}第纳尔, 工资上限为{WAGE_LIMIT}第纳尔. 家族领袖拥有{LEADER_GOLD}第纳尔, 当前处于{WAR_STATE}状态.
{=ModifiedArmy_PartyWageLimitExceeded}[部队财政] {PARTY_NAME}每日工资为{CURRENT_WAGE}第纳尔, 已超过{WAGE_LIMIT}第纳尔的上限. 若工资没有降低, 部队将解散士兵.
{=ModifiedArmy_AIRecruitmentGarrisonPlan}[AI招募] {SETTLEMENT_NAME}驻军有{OFFERED}名志愿兵候选, 实际招募{APPROVED}名, 每日上限{DAILY_LIMIT}名. 当前使用{CULTURE_ID}文化模板, 首要限制是{LIMIT}.
{=ModifiedArmy_GarrisonMarketPurchase}[驻军后勤] {SETTLEMENT_NAME}从市场购买{PURCHASED}单位食物, 花费{COST}第纳尔, 驻军粮仓现有{CURRENT_FOOD}单位食物.
{=ModifiedArmy_GarrisonLocalProduction}[驻军后勤] {SETTLEMENT_NAME}将{TRANSFERRED}单位本地产出送入驻军粮仓, 粮仓现有{CURRENT_FOOD}单位食物.
{=ModifiedArmy_GarrisonFoodConsumption}[驻军后勤] {SETTLEMENT_NAME}驻军需要{DEMAND}单位食物, 库存从{FOOD_BEFORE}降至{FOOD_AFTER}, 剩余消耗进度为{REMAINDER}%, 饥饿状态为{STARVING}.
{=ModifiedArmy_PartyTroopsDeserted}[部队损耗] {PARTY_NAME}因{REASON}逃亡{DESERTED}人, 目前还剩{REMAINING}人.
{=ModifiedArmy_PartyDisbandStarted}[部队解散] {PARTY_NAME}开始解散, 当前共有{MEMBERS}人.
{=ModifiedArmy_SupplyPartyLoaded}[驻军后勤] {HOME_NAME}征粮队在{SOURCE_NAME}获得{FOOD}单位食物, 花费{COST}第纳尔. 队伍购买{MOUNTS}匹马, 花费{MOUNT_COST}第纳尔, 现携带{CARGO_FOOD}单位食物.
{=ModifiedArmy_SupplyPartyDestroyed}[驻军后勤] {HOME_NAME}的征粮队已被消灭, 定居点需要等待{COOLDOWN_DAYS}天才能再次派出征粮队.
{=ModifiedArmy_SupplyPartyCreationFailed}[驻军后勤] {HOME_NAME}无法创建征粮队. 错误信息为{ERROR}.
{=ModifiedArmy_SupplyPartyDispatched}[驻军后勤] {HOME_NAME}派出{ESCORT}人的征粮队前往{SOURCE_NAME}, 计划运回{REQUESTED}单位食物.
{=ModifiedArmy_SupplyPartyReturned}[驻军后勤] {HOME_NAME}征粮队带回{FOOD}单位食物.
{=ModifiedArmy_GarrisonWageDismissalPrevented}[驻军工资] {OWNER_NAME}所属定居点{SETTLEMENT_NAME}, 工资上限已从{PREVIOUS_LIMIT}提高到{NEW_LIMIT}第纳尔, 避免了驻军解散.
{=ModifiedArmy_GarrisonWageStillExceeded}[驻军工资] {OWNER_NAME}所属定居点{SETTLEMENT_NAME}, 驻军每日工资为{CURRENT_WAGE}第纳尔, 已超过{NEW_LIMIT}第纳尔的上限. 若工资没有降低, 驻军将解散士兵.
{=ModifiedArmy_RecruitmentConfigLoaded}[配置] AI招募配置已加载, 包含{CULTURE_COUNT}条文化偏好和{SITUATION_COUNT}条情境修正. 需求阈值为{NEED_THRESHOLD}, 随机概率为{RANDOM_CHANCE}.
{=ModifiedArmy_RecruitmentConfigMissing}[配置] 未找到AI招募配置节点, 将使用默认值.
{=ModifiedArmy_RecruitmentCultureInvalid}[配置] 无法识别文化{CULTURE_ID}, 已跳过该文化的AI招募配置.
{=ModifiedArmy_FiefDailyProsperityLoss}[封邑] {SETTLEMENT_NAME}因维持{RECRUITED_COUNT}名被征召的封邑兵, 今日损失{PROSPERITY_LOSS}点繁荣度.
{=ModifiedArmy_FiefPrisonerRecruited}[封邑] {SETTLEMENT_NAME}的封邑部队从俘虏中招募了{COUNT}名{TROOP_NAME}.
